about: Verification, makers' photos and documents for the item cards (RIG_BUILD.md §13.8). METADATA ONLY: the files are the makers' copyright, used as internal reference on the studio's local install; they are never in this repository. scripts/rigbuild/fetch-equipment-media.mjs re-fetches each url, checks its sha256 and stores it in the local install's space `store.space` (the id there is `asset`).

evidence.what: JSON-LD PropertyValue on the page: "Model NO.": "UP-B380F"
second made-in-china store listing for the same UPlight 380W IP65 beam

verification.note: Re-checked the made-in-china store page: its embedded JSON-LD prints "Model NO.": "UP-B380F" verbatim. Also searched pro-uplight.com's own site search (phoenix/admin/prod/search) for "B380F" and "380W beam" — both returned totalCount 0, so this code is not on UPlight's own pro-uplight.com catalogue, only on its made-in-china store (same maker, per fixtures.json). No UPlight/pro-uplight manual or DMX chart was found anywhere (web search, site search, /download.html — that page's file list loads via a gated phoenix/admin/download endpoint that returned empty to a plain GET). Used an equivalent IP65 380W beam manual from a different maker (UPlus Lighting) for a DMX chart; specs line up closely (2° beam, IP65, 16-channel mode) though the exact wattage figures differ slightly from the catalogue's 500W estimate.
